text:
The response is highly helpful, relevant, and accurate, covering many core Japanese business etiquette norms such as punctuality, meishi exchange, bowing, gift-giving, dress code, meetings, consensus decision-making, indirect communication, and socializing. It is well-organized and detailed. Minor oversimplifications exist—e.g., arriving a few minutes early is generally fine but not always ideal, and gift-giving is not universally expected—but these do not significantly detract from the overall quality.

Rating: [[9]]
